audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows contradicted this page's own whys prose and the packet chart. win[0] said Skill while whys[0] says 'Level 1 is yours'; win[3] said Skill while whys[3] says 'Level 4 favors Poppy'; win[4] said Skill while whys[4] says 'At 6 your R and Maiden overpower her'. Rows 1 and 2 also disagreed with the poppy__yorick mirror, which flipped them.
audit.why: Poppy has no combo at all until Heroic Charge exists, so level 1 belongs to Yorick's Last Rites auto. Level 4 is her one real window — Heroic Charge into a wall on 14s. Level 6 flips it permanently because Eulogy of the Isles beats a champion with no sustain in an extended fight.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Yorick / Skill / Skill / Poppy / Yorick / Yorick / Yorick across win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side as one paired group, ratings 6/5/5/3/6/6/7. No whys needed changing — they already described this chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike or phase named a cooldown (packet defect: sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10s, Hammer Shock 8s falling to 4s, Steadfast Presence 20s falling to 12s and Keeper's Verdict 140/120/100s. The level 4 window and the level 6 flip are both cooldown facts, and without the numbers the reader cannot time either.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into spikes[0].text, phases[1..5].why, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.feeding.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate ability errors, plus one missing interaction. (a) spikes[0].text calls Poppy's Q 'Iron Ambassador' — that is her passive; the Q is Hammer Shock. (b) spikes[0].text and wants.foe[1] say Steadfast Presence 'can stun' you. (c) spikes[0].text and mid warn that Steadfast Presence 'blocks your dashes' — Yorick has no dash. (d) Nothing said that Dark Procession is itself a wall Poppy can stun you against.
audit.why: Riot's Steadfast Presence text: she gains Move Speed and stops enemy dashes around her; 'If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded' — slowed and grounded, never stunned, and only if a dash was stopped. Against Yorick nothing is stopped, because Riot's Mourning Mist text is a thrown globule that moves his summoned units, not him. So her W is effectively a stat button in this lane, which is a real advantage worth telling the player about. The stun is Heroic Charge and only on wall contact: 'If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.' Dark Procession summons a destructible wall — so a Yorick who cages near himself has built her stun surface for her.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text rewritten with Hammer Shock named correctly, the stun attributed to wall contact only, and Steadfast Presence's dash-stop called out as irrelevant here. wants.foe[1] now says slow and ground. The 'your own cage is a wall' rule added to phases[3].why, dontsFull[0].d and mid.

notes: Best finding here: Steadfast Presence is nearly dead weight against Yorick. It stops dashes, and Riot's Mourning Mist text gives Yorick no dash at all (the move speed goes to his summoned units), so the page's repeated warnings about her 'blocking your dashes' were misleading the player into playing scared of a button that cannot touch him. The yorick.json 'dash' flag on Mourning Mist is the tooltip-parse misfire behind it. Also corrected: Poppy's Q is Hammer Shock, not Iron Ambassador (that is her passive), and Steadfast Presence slows and grounds a stopped dash — it never stuns. The stun is Heroic Charge on wall contact only, which makes Yorick's own Dark Procession a liability if placed beside himself.
